text:
tiffany.l: Hey folks — I tried accepting the GitHub org invite but it says the invite bounced (deliverability error) and links to my personal no-reply address? I only used my work email when signing up. Anyone know who handles re-sending invites or fixing email alias issues?
ben.peopleops: welcome! pinging IT, @it-support-bot — can you check if the invite went to the right address and re-send if needed? :wave:
it-support-bot: Thanks @ben.peopleops — checking now. Can you confirm the work email you used, @tiffany.l?
tiffany.l: yes — tiffany.l@redwood.ai (I also briefly tried to accept from my phone where my personal github account is logged in).
it-support-bot: Looks like the invite bounced because GitHub rejected the initial delivery due to an uncommon reply-to header (their mail provider flagged it). I can reissue the org invite to tiffany.l@redwood.ai now. Do you want us to also pre-add you to frontend-team so you can see repos immediately?
mike-eng: Please add to frontend-team and the onboarding repo perms. Also give repo: redwood/web-app read + triage on redwood/infra if possible.
it-support-bot: Re-sent invite at 2026-02-14T09:22:00Z. Also created a placeholder GitHub invite token and flagged it for manual accept if SSO blocks. If you hit SSO, accept via work account in the same browser (or use an incognito window).
tiffany.l: got the email! It shows "Accept invite" but when I click it it redirects to sign in and then says "account conflict: this account is associated with a different email" — I do have a personal GH account with the same name. What do I do?
ben.peopleops: common — two options: 1) claim the org invite using your work email by adding that email to your personal account then switching it off (messy), or 2) we can invite you to the org as a new user to your work email and then we ask GitHub Support to disconnect the personal account. IT usually handles route 2 for clean onboarding. @it-support-bot?
it-support-bot: Agreed. I'll create a fresh invite using the "Invite by email (create new account)" flow and mark it as "require new account" so it won't try to merge with existing. Doing that now. Also adding you to frontend-team and onboarding repo as requested.
devex-sara: Quick tip for future new-hires: if you see SSO redirect loops, try `gh auth login --web` and pick your work org so the token maps to the correct account. Saves a lot of back-and-forth.
it-support-bot: Fresh invite sent at 2026-02-14T09:35:10Z using explicit new-account flow. Frontend-team + redwood/web-app read + redwood/onboarding write added. Please accept within 7 days.
tiffany.l: Accepted! I can see the repos now. Thanks everyone :heart_eyes: Any quick checklist for initial repo access / SSH keys?
mike-eng: Add SSH key to GH, clone `git@github.com:redwood/web-app.git`, run `yarn bootstrap` (see README), and join #eng-oncall later for a quick 20m onboarding.
it-support-bot: Done: added tiffany.l to frontend-team, invited to oncall rotation as observer. If you want push access to specific repos, open a PR in infra/repo-access or DM me.
tiffany.l: all set — can push to my fork and opened an access request for infra. Thanks y'all! :tada:
